items.title: Undefined registers in inline bitboard operations
items.summary: The recovered inline-bitboard caller reproduces all four historical undefined-register errors on a reconstructed fork differing only by absence of existing patch 0028. Identical retained IR passes with 0028, and the recovered probe matches the host oracle on a16 and xy16 in bsnes-jg. The same C input passes supported unpatched-upstream configurations.
items.nextStep: Carry the 0028 root fix with the compiler feature series.

items.title: GlobalISel physical-register inline-asm range exhaustion
items.summary: An i128 AArch64 inline-asm operand constrained to {cc} exhausts the one-register class and asserts. Patch 0056 validates the whole physical-register range, diagnoses invalid constraints, and defines error-recovery results without invoking fallback. The identical IR changes from an assertion to the expected clean diagnostic on the isolated candidate.

items.title: llvm-reduce crashes reducing MIR with two workers
items.summary: The retained MIR input crashes the preserved llvm-reduce with -j 2; keeping MachineModuleInfo in each parallel MIR work item lets the same input reduce successfully while preserving IR bitcode workers.
items.nextStep: Check published-upstream applicability of patch 0060.

items.title: 65816 bank relaxation ignores a section offset above 65535
items.summary: Fixed: an out-of-bank section-relative symbol can relax to long addressing even when its section is not marked far.

items.title: 0015 coalescing witness: undefined lane after identity-copy removal
items.summary: The retained rcundef.c witness reproduces the historical undefined-rc3 signature on an identified current fork reconstructed without 0015 and 0028. Adding only existing patch 0028 repairs the same IR; 0015 is a trigger-avoidance workaround for this witness. Rewriter output differs only by three KILL pseudos, with identical register assignments. The existing eight-instruction model reproduces on saved unpatched upstream 742d554 using mos6502; stock C reachability remains unproven.

items.title: Far memset selects the near runtime and loses the destination bank
items.summary: The June 26 4096-byte fill is causally repaired by existing a81874d / patch 0013. Identical retained IR calls near __memset without the patch (4096 physical bytes wrong, checksum 0) and __memset_far with it (all bytes 0x42, checksum 0x2000). The baseline compiler is explicitly reconstructed; no new compiler fix was needed.
items.nextStep: Existing a81874d / 0013 repair revalidated; carry far compiler/ABI and runtime integration with the feature series.

items.title: MOS float-vector arithmetic and scalarization prerequisites
items.summary: Fixed: vector arithmetic reaches scalar float/double libcalls; generic vector prerequisites are backported at the pinned revision.

items.title: Independent Imag8-only rejection hypothesis for i8-to-i1 truncation (0023)
items.summary: The independent claim that an Imag8 source rejects the s8-to-s1 pattern is disproved at vendor pin 8be0546 and saved upstream 742d554: both classes map to Any, and the generated matcher inserts an Ac copy. All 72 compiler runs and 48 selection checks pass. No fix or red baseline is claimed; the unrecovered historical #320 far-pointer observation remains qualified.
items.nextStep: Independent Imag8-only rejection diagnosis disproved. Retain 0023 and its tests with the feature series; the separate historical far-pointer observation still requires its original input and failing compiler.

items.title: O0 65816 vector code exhausts status-register scavenging
items.summary: Fixed: backward scavenger search rechecks target save feasibility before extending the selected spill range. Both original vector tests compile at O0 in a16 and xy16.

items.title: XY16 gallery near decoder fails with a split indirect Y index
items.summary: The inherited XY16 gallery failure reproduces on reconstructed committed main: all-work benchmark returns 0xA50F instead of 0x5CF0. Non-LTO decode_near contains a wide LDY followed by SEP #$10 before its indirect Y use. Existing e6433296 restores X, not Y. The exact causal contribution of this sequence to the LTO benchmark still needs isolation; no near-path fix is included in increment 2.
items.nextStep: Isolate the near-Y contribution to the reproduced XY16 gallery failure and retain the failing baseline before attempting repair.

items.title: Zero-page indexed addressing emits a same-width G_TRUNC
items.summary: Fixed: byte-sized zero-page indices retain their existing width instead of producing G_TRUNC s8 to s8.

items.title: Reentrant attribute versus inferred static frames
items.summary: The frontend opt-out works; backend analysis can infer nonreentrant again. This confirms that the attribute does not force soft-stack frames, without establishing a supported-program miscompile.
items.nextStep: Agree the attribute's semantics before selecting a backend or documentation change.

items.title: SelectionDAG nonstandard integer inline-asm type abort
items.summary: Patch 0058 rejects MVT::Other before AArch64 r/x register-class size queries. The original i4096 input aborts on both preserved builds and receives a clean allocation diagnostic with the guard. All 32 rejection configurations and supported controls pass; the full callbr regression depends on 0057 error recovery. The separate vector conversion assertion is fixed by patch 0059; its own record retains the evidence.

items.title: SelectionDAG physical-register inline-asm range exhaustion
items.summary: Patch 0057 validates physical-register ranges before assignment and uses the existing register/type diagnostic. Callbr landing pads return undefined recovery values after lowering errors instead of walking absent output copy chains. Seven isolated operand forms abort on the preserved baseline and receive exactly one clean diagnostic on the candidate at O0 and O2.

items.title: SelectionDAG vector inline-asm part-type assertion
items.summary: Patch 0059 diagnoses incompatible vector register parts and lossy vector-to-scalar conversion after target-specific conversion hooks. The unchanged <64 x i64> input aborts on preserved 0057 and 0058 compilers and receives the expected diagnostic on the identified candidate. Supported scalarized, bitcast, and LS64 cases remain accepted; MOS Clang/LLD are rebuilt and installed.

items.title: Narrow-count 64-bit shift legalization
items.summary: Patch 0055 legalizes native-width s8/s16/s32-to-s64 ANYEXT through the existing zero-extension path. The same recovered preprocessed input fails on the preserved baseline and passes on the rebuilt compiler; retained IR and a reduced valid IR input discriminate the backend repair. All 36 source configurations and six SNES runtime checks pass.
items.nextStep: Submit 0055 with the native-width compiler series.
